title: The Winter of the Ninth Floor
author: Petra Halloran
blurb: Odile Ashgrove, a folklorist recording songs the village refuses to sing twice, keeps the lights on and the doors counted. Then the sleep recordings capture a second voice answering questions — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must return what was taken in 1974 before the last resident signs the papers.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
